entries.en: ...You came before the sand ran out.

entries.ko: 알고 있다. 시계 속 모래가 말라 버렸어.
entries.en: I know. The sand inside has dried up.
entries.zh: 我知道。钟里的沙子干了。

entries.ko: 흐르는 모래가 있어야 바늘이 다시 간다.
entries.en: The hands need Flowing Sand to move again.
entries.zh: 得有流淌之沙，指针才会再走。

entries.ko: 시간의 문 너머, 처음 길을 막아서는 큰 놈이 그걸 품고 있지.
entries.en: Past the Time Gate, the first big one to block your path... it carries some.
entries.zh: 时间之门那边，第一个挡路的大家伙，身上就揣着那个。

entries.ko: 가져오면 바늘을 채워 주마. 남는 모래로는 탄도 부어 주고.
entries.en: Bring it, and I'll fill the hands. What's left, I'll cast into bullets.
entries.zh: 拿来，我就把指针填满。剩下的沙子，也给你铸成子弹。

entries.ko: 시간의 문 너머, 처음 길을 막아서는 큰 놈이다.
entries.en: Past the Time Gate. The first big one in your path.
entries.zh: 时间之门那边，第一个挡路的大家伙。

entries.zh: <color=#FFD54A>下一局从第一个中BOSS那里取得{0}</color>

entries.ko: 아직 따뜻하군. 누군가 오래 쥐고 있던 모래야.
entries.en: Still warm. Someone held this sand for a long time.
entries.zh: 还是暖的。是有人握了很久的沙子。

entries.ko: 바늘 한쪽은 채웠다. 나머지는 내 손으론 안 돼.
entries.en: One hand is filled. The rest is beyond me.
entries.zh: 一根指针填好了。剩下的，我的手做不到。

entries.en: Go find the Sheriff on the west island.
entries.zh: 去找西边岛上的警长吧。

entries.en: That one talks with a gun, not words.
entries.zh: 那家伙不用嘴说话，用枪说。

entries.ko: 공방도 다시 열었다. 새 탄을 부으려면 조각을 가져와.
entries.en: The workshop's open again. Bring Time Shards, and I'll cast new bullets.
entries.zh: 工坊也重新开了。想铸新子弹，就把碎片带来。

entries.en: The Smith sent you, did he.

entries.ko: 내 얼굴은 필름과 함께 바랬어. 하지만 총은 아직 기억하지.
entries.en: My face faded along with the film. But the gun... it still remembers.
entries.zh: 我的脸随着胶片一起褪色了。可枪，还记得。

entries.ko: 바늘을 움직이고 싶다면, 한 번 겨뤄 보세.
entries.en: If you want the hands to move, let's have ourselves a duel.
entries.zh: 想让指针动起来，就来比试一场吧。

entries.ko: 종이 울리면 뽑게. 먼저 뽑으면 처음부터야.
entries.en: Draw when the bell rings. Draw early, and we start over.
entries.zh: 钟响了再拔枪。抢先拔，就从头来过。

entries.en: The same hands that tried to hold back a departing train.
entries.zh: 是那双想拉住远去列车的手啊。

entries.ko: 총포상을 다시 열지. 바늘도 이제 돌 거야.
entries.en: I'll open the Gunsmith again. The hands will turn now, too.
entries.zh: 枪械店再开张吧。指针也会转起来了。

entries.en: Mirror Box — Go to the open side!
entries.zh: 镜子箱 — 往开口那边去！

entries.en: Find the Real One — On the mirrored clock, shoot the magician standing at your current Firing Hour!
entries.zh: 找出真身 — 在镜中时钟上，射击站在你当前发射时刻位置的魔术师！

entries.en: {0} o'clock — Found the real one, magician stunned!
entries.zh: {0}点位置 — 找到真身，魔术师眩晕！

entries.zh: 时间到 — 真身在{0}点位置，分身们反击！

entries.en: Mirror Clocks — Odd number of clocks: stand on one. Even: stand outside them all!
entries.zh: 镜中时钟 — 时钟数为奇数就站到时钟上，偶数就站在所有时钟外！

entries.en: The mirror shattered — The whale takes to the sky!
entries.zh: 镜子碎了 — 鲸鱼飞上了天空！

entries.ko: 거울에 비친 시각 — 바닥 시계는 좌우가 뒤집혀 있다. 실제 시각 탄을 원 가운데에!
entries.en: Mirrored Hour — The floor clock is flipped left to right. Shoot the circle's center with the true-hour bullet!

鲸之歌 — 数清鸣叫次数

entries.zh: 头部发光 — 用鸣叫次数时刻的子弹射击头部！

entries.zh: 记忆碎片全部击碎 — 鲸鱼眩晕！

entries.zh: 剩余碎片{0}个 — 鲸鱼吞下碎片冲锋！

entries.en: I thought I'd forgotten the song.
entries.zh: 还以为我已经忘了那首歌。

entries.ko: 누군가 날 뒤집어 주던 손이 있었지.
entries.en: There was a hand that used to turn me over.
entries.zh: 曾经有一双手，会把我翻过来。

entries.ko: 그 손이 없으니 모래가 새기만 하는군.
entries.en: Without it, the sand only runs out.
entries.zh: 没了那双手，沙子就只会漏下去。

entries.en: This coat... who wore it, again.
entries.zh: 这件外套，是谁穿过来着。

entries.en: Heroes only ever lived on the screen.
entries.zh: 英雄，总是只活在银幕里。

entries.en: This sound... I heard it every evening.
entries.zh: 这个声音...是每天傍晚都会听见的。

entries.en: I was sewing clothes for someone.
How many times did you fall today?

entries.ko: 서두를 거 없어. 시계는 어차피 갈 테니까.
entries.en: No need to hurry. The clock moves on anyway.
entries.zh: 不用急。反正时钟总会走的。

entries.ko: 넌 싸우고, 난 기다리고. 그게 우리 몫이야.
entries.en: You fight, I wait. That's our part.
entries.zh: 你去战斗，我来等待。这是我们各自的事。

entries.en: I'm not you. Well... only half.
entries.zh: 我不是你。准确地说...只有一半是。

entries.ko: 거울 속엔 원래 있던 것들이 비쳐.
entries.en: The mirror shows things as they used to be.
entries.zh: 镜子里映出的，是原本的样子。

entries.ko: 비친 자리 말고, 그게 진짜 있어야 할 자리를 쏴.
entries.en: Not where it's reflected. Shoot where it truly belongs.
entries.zh: 别打映出来的位置，打它本该在的位置。

entries.ko: <color=#FFD54A>거울 속 물건이 원래 있어야 할 자리를 찾아 쏘세요</color>
entries.en: <color=#FFD54A>Find where each mirrored object truly belongs and shoot that spot</color>
entries.zh: <color=#FFD54A>找到镜中物品原本应在的位置并射击</color>

entries.en: Now the Plaza. The last one's yours.
entries.zh: 现在去广场。最后一面归你。

entries.en: Break it, and the reflection stays the same.
entries.zh: 就算打碎，映出的东西也不会变。

entries.en: I'll be here. Look in anytime.
entries.zh: 我会在这里。随时来看看吧。

entries.ko: 분명 누군가가 이 시계를 붙잡고 있었는데....
entries.en: Someone was holding this clock, I'm sure of it....
entries.zh: 一定有谁曾紧紧握着这座钟....
.....这沙子里到底藏着什么秘密..??

entries.en: When time stops, heroes don't grow old.
entries.zh: 时间停下，英雄就不会老。

entries.en: Whether that's good, I can't say.
entries.zh: 那是不是好事，我也说不清。

entries.ko: 멈춘 바늘로는 아무것도 지을 수 없어.
entries.en: You can't sew a thing with a stopped needle.
entries.zh: 停住的针，什么也缝不了。

entries.ko: 바느질을 할때는 시작만큼이나 끝맺음도 중요한 법이야.
entries.en: In sewing, the final knot matters as much as the first stitch.
entries.zh: 做针线活时，收尾和起针一样重要。

entries.en: This time, a clock has stopped on every island.
entries.zh: 这次，每座岛上的时钟都停了。

entries.ko: 시계에 적힌 시각대로 다시 감아 줘.
entries.en: Wind them again to the hours written on them.
entries.zh: 照着钟上写的时刻，重新上好发条吧。

entries.en: <color=#FFD54A>Find each island's stopped clock and shoot it with bullets matching the gear numbers</color>
entries.zh: <color=#FFD54A>找到每座岛上停摆的时钟，用齿轮数字时刻的子弹射击</color>

entries.ko: 그건 네가 감을 수 있는 시계가 아니야.
entries.en: That's not a clock you can wind.
entries.zh: 那不是你能上发条的钟。

成功 — 克罗诺 & 坦波眩晕！

entries.zh: 表盘停下了 — 克罗诺 & 坦波眩晕！

entries.zh: 死亡时刻 — 用{0}点的子弹射击脸上的时钟！

entries.zh: 时钟碎了 — 时间之主停下了！

entries.en: Missed the hour — Time is shaved off
entries.zh: 错过时刻 — 时间被削减

entries.en: Sealed — The Master of Time is bound!
entries.zh: 封印 — 时间之主被束缚了！

entries.zh: 时间之主召唤出逝去的时光！

entries.ko: 이제야 생각났어. 이 외투, 네 거였지.
entries.en: Now I remember. This coat was yours.
entries.zh: 现在才想起来。这件外套，是你的吧。

entries.en: The sand has all run down.
Don't turn it over this time.
entries.zh: 这次别再把它翻过来了。

entries.en: I've sewn on the very last button.
entries.zh: 最后一颗纽扣也缝好了。

entries.en: The song... I remember it now.
...I'll call out for you, just once more.
And it's not a door I keep.
Will you look in once more?

entries.en: Misalignment — The Mirror Cat begins to slip out of sync
entries.zh: 错位 — 镜中猫开始错位

entries.en: Fragments — Only the one with a shadow is real!
entries.zh: 碎片 — 只有带影子的才是真身！

entries.zh: 破碎镜墙 — 射击镜子把它打碎！

entries.ko: 그림자 찾기 — 그림자가 있는 진짜를 맞혀라!
entries.en: Find the Shadow — Hit the real one, the one with a shadow!
entries.zh: 寻找影子 — 击中带影子的真身！

entries.ko: 거울 너머 저격 — 그가 비친 벽 거울을 쏴라!

entries.zh: 镜后狙击 — 射击映出他身影的墙镜！

entries.en: Pulled out of the mirror — Stunned!
entries.zh: 从镜中拖出来了 — 眩晕！

entries.en: ......Glasses? One lens has a magnifier on it.
entries.zh: ......眼镜？一边镜片上装着放大镜啊。

entries.en: These glasses were worn a long, long time.

entries.ko: 아주 작은 걸 오래 들여다본 사람의 것이야.
entries.en: They belonged to someone who spent years peering at tiny things.
entries.zh: 属于一个长年盯着微小东西看的人。

entries.ko: 톱니 하나, 나사 하나...... 평생을 그렇게 보냈겠지.
entries.en: One gear, one screw...... a whole life spent that way, I suppose.
entries.zh: 一个齿轮，一颗螺丝......一辈子大概就这样过去了吧。

entries.ko: 작업대 위 흐린 시야 — 핀셋 끝의 작은 톱니
entries.en: Blurred view over a workbench — a tiny gear at the tip of tweezers
entries.zh: 工作台上模糊的视野 — 镊子尖上的小齿轮

entries.en: Just slip through the smoke. There's always a gap.
entries.zh: 从烟雾间穿过去就行。总会有缝隙的。

entries.en: Slip through the gaps in the smoke rings
entries.zh: 从烟圈的缝隙中穿过去

entries.en: You came. The train leaves soon.
entries.zh: 你来了啊。火车马上就要开了。

entries.en: I'll be back soon. I promise.
No... not yet. Just a little longer.
entries.zh: 不行...还没到时候。再等一会儿。

entries.ko: 기관차 앞으로 — 헤드라이트 시계가 가리키는 시각에 쏜 탄을 헤드라이트에 맞히세요
entries.en: To the front of the locomotive — hit the headlight with a bullet fired at the hour the headlight clock shows
entries.zh: 前往机车前方 — 用在车头灯时钟所指时刻射出的子弹击中车头灯

entries.ko: ...뭐든 상관없어. 이 기차는 아직 못 보낸다.
entries.en: ...Don't care what it is. This train ain't leavin' yet.
entries.zh: ...管它是什么。这趟车还不能走。

entries.ko: 헤드라이트 시계 {0}시 — 발사 시각이 {1}시일 때 쏜 탄을 헤드라이트에 맞히세요
entries.en: Headlight clock at {0} o'clock — hit the headlight with a bullet fired when the Firing Hour is {1}
entries.zh: 车头灯时钟{0}点 — 用发射时刻为{1}点时射出的子弹击中车头灯

entries.ko: 대화 없이 패턴만 — 언제든 Enter를 길게 눌러 끝내고 보스 방으로
entries.en: Patterns only, no dialogue — hold Enter anytime to finish and head to the boss room
entries.zh: 只有模式，没有对话 — 随时长按Enter结束并前往BOSS房间
练习 — 生命值已回满

entries.en: Practice over — to the boss room
entries.zh: 练习结束 — 前往BOSS房间

entries.ko: 같은 특성의 탄을 함께 장전하면 시너지가 생겨요.
entries.en: Load bullets with the same Trait together to form a Synergy.
entries.zh: 把相同特性的子弹一起装填，就会产生协同。

entries.ko: 2 · 4 · 6발을 모을 때마다 효과가 한 단계씩 강해져요.
entries.en: At 2 · 4 · 6 bullets, the effect grows one Tier stronger.
entries.zh: 每凑齐2 · 4 · 6发，效果就提升一阶。

entries.ko: 지금 켜진 시너지는 이곳에서 확인할 수 있어요.
entries.en: You can check your active Synergies here.
entries.zh: 当前生效的协同可以在这里查看。

entries.ko: 같은 동작을 하는 작은 아이 손
entries.en: A small child's hands making the same motion
entries.zh: 做着同样动作的小孩的手

entries.en: Ticking and heartbeat falling out of step

entries.ko: 노을 진 시골 시계탑을 올려다보는 아이
entries.en: A child looking up at a country clock tower at sunset
entries.zh: 仰望晚霞中乡村钟楼的孩子

entries.ko: 천장 조명이 빠르게 지나가는 병원 복도
entries.en: A hospital corridor, ceiling lights rushing past
entries.zh: 天花板灯光飞速掠过的医院走廊

entries.en: A hand reflected in a departing train's window
entries.zh: 映在远去火车车窗上的手

entries.en: A hospital window streaked with rain
A muffled voice: 'I'll be back soon'
A photo of a woman, washed out by light
entries.zh: 被光遮住的女人的照片

entries.en: Spilled water flowing backward into the cup
An IV drip, falling drop by drop

entries.ko: 빨간 실이 풀리는 맞잡은 두 손
entries.en: Two clasped hands, a red thread coming loose
entries.zh: 红线松开的紧握的双手

entries.en: Old hands seizing the pendulum to stop it
entries.zh: 抓住钟摆让它停下的苍老双手

entries.en: The red minute hand held at 11:59
A picture book turned to its last page
entries.zh: 翻到最后一页的图画书

entries.en: The cat laying down its guns
The hand held out by the woman in the red shawl

entries.en: A cup, nudged, tipping over the edge (close)
entries.zh: 被碰倒、从边缘倾落的杯子（近景）

entries.en: The cup falling to the floor (floor level)
entries.zh: 落向地面的杯子（地面高度）

entries.ko: 태엽을 감는 주름진 손 + 겹친 아이 손
entries.en: Wrinkled hands winding a spring + a child's hands overlaid
entries.zh: 上发条的布满皱纹的手 + 叠上的孩子的手

entries.en: The ceiling seen from a stretcher
entries.zh: 从担架上仰望的天花板
被推走的视角：医院走廊

entries.en: A child looking up at the clock tower at sunset
entries.zh: 仰望晚霞中钟楼的孩子

entries.en: The clock tower's clock from below (dolly zoom)
entries.zh: 仰视钟楼的时钟（滑动变焦）

entries.en: A child running toward the clock tower
Crash zoom on the clock tower · it cracks
entries.zh: 钟楼急推 · 出现裂纹

entries.en: Cracks spreading across the clock tower
The clock tower shattering like glass
entries.zh: 像玻璃一样碎裂的钟楼
无声的医生嘴巴（滑动变焦）

entries.en: A trembling hand reaches for the glass on the nightstand
entries.zh: 颤抖的手伸向床头柜上的水杯

entries.en: The glass, back in its place
A hand holding the old man's hand tight

entries.ko: ......지금은 잠자리 같은 걸 신경 쓸 때가 아니다.
entries.en: ......No time to fret over where I slept.
entries.zh: ......现在不是在意睡在哪儿的时候。

entries.en: First things first. Deal with what's right in front of me.
entries.zh: 先把眼前的火灭了再说。

entries.ko: 우클릭하면 뒤로 물러나며 두 발을 쏴요.
entries.en: Right Click to step back and fire two shots.
entries.zh: 按右键会边后撤边射出两发子弹。

entries.en: You can't be hit while stepping back.
entries.zh: 后撤的瞬间不会受到攻击。

entries.ko: 한 번 쓰면 6초 뒤에 다시 쓸 수 있어요.
entries.en: After use, it's ready again in 6 seconds.
entries.zh: 使用后6秒即可再次使用。

entries.en: Try a Backstep Shot with <color=#FFD54A>Right Click</color>.
entries.zh: 用<color=#FFD54A>右键</color>试试后撤射击吧。

entries.en: Each cylinder slot stands for an hour on the clock.
entries.zh: 弹巢的每一格都代表时钟上的一个时刻。

entries.en: Every shot you fire moves time forward,
entries.zh: 每开一枪，时间就会流逝，

entries.en: and as time passes, you might gain
entries.zh: 随着时间流逝，你也许能获得

entries.en: Each of the Bullet Clock's 12 slots is an hour.
entries.zh: 子弹时钟的12格各代表一个时刻。

entries.en: Bullets fire in order, from Slot 1 to Slot 12.
entries.zh: 子弹会从1点格到12点格依次发射。

entries.ko: 탄이 놓인 칸의 시각이 그 탄의 '판정 시각'이에요.
entries.en: The hour of a bullet's slot is its 'Judgment Hour'.
entries.zh: 子弹所在格的时刻，就是这颗子弹的「判定时刻」。

entries.ko: 판정 시각이 탄의 시각 조건에 맞으면 탄이 활성화돼요.
entries.en: When the Judgment Hour meets the bullet's hour condition, the bullet activates.
entries.zh: 判定时刻满足子弹的时刻条件时，子弹就会激活。

entries.ko: 지금 '{0}'은 {1}시 칸에 있어요 → 판정 시각 {2}시 · 조건 '{3}' → {4}
entries.en: '{0}' is in Slot {1} → Judgment Hour {2} · Condition '{3}' → {4}

entries.ko: 지금 '{0}'은 보관함에 있어요 → 탄환 시계 칸에 넣어야 판정 시각이 생겨요. (조건 '{1}')
entries.en: '{0}' is in Storage → Put it in a Bullet Clock slot to give it a Judgment Hour. (Condition '{1}')
entries.zh: 现在「{0}」在仓库中 → 放进子弹时钟的格里才会有判定时刻。（条件「{1}」）

entries.ko: '{0}'을 조건에 맞는 칸으로 끌어 옮겨 보세요.
entries.en: Drag '{0}' to a slot that meets its condition.
entries.zh: 把「{0}」拖到满足条件的格里试试。

entries.ko: 활성화됐어요! 금빛 칸의 탄은 특성과 고유 효과가 켜져요.
entries.en: Activated! Bullets in gold slots turn on their Traits and Unique Effects.
entries.zh: 已激活！金色格里的子弹会开启特性和专属效果。

entries.ko: 탄에 마우스를 올리면 시각 조건과 지금 판정 시각을 볼 수 있어요.
entries.en: Hover over a bullet to see its hour condition and current Judgment Hour.
entries.zh: 鼠标悬停在子弹上，可以查看时刻条件和当前判定时刻。

entries.ko: '{0}'이 활성화되면 양옆 칸 탄의 판정 시각이 +{1} 돼요. 연산을 다 계산한 다음에 더해져요.
entries.en: When '{0}' activates, bullets in the neighboring slots get Judgment Hour +{1}. It's added after all Operators are applied.
entries.zh: 「{0}」激活时，左右相邻格子弹的判定时刻 +{1}。在所有运算符计算完之后再加上。

entries.en: Hah, ain't lost my touch yet!

entries.ko: <color=#FFD54A>연산</color> 문: 탄의 판정 시각을 바꾸는 연산을 얻을 수 있어요.
entries.en: <color=#FFD54A>Operator</color> Door: get Operators that change a bullet's Judgment Hour.
entries.zh: <color=#FFD54A>运算</color>之门：可以获得改变子弹判定时刻的运算符。

entries.ko: 연산은 탄에 끼워 판정 시각을 바꾸는 계산이에요.
entries.en: Operators are calculations you slot into a bullet to change its Judgment Hour.
entries.zh: 运算符是装进子弹、改变判定时刻的计算。

entries.ko: 탄을 다른 칸으로 옮기지 않아도 조건을 맞출 수 있어요.
entries.en: You can meet a condition without moving the bullet to another slot.
entries.zh: 不用把子弹挪到别的格，也能满足条件。

entries.en: Click a bullet to open the 'Bullet Upgrade' window.
entries.zh: 点击子弹会打开「子弹强化」窗口。

entries.ko: 보관함의 연산을 이 칸으로 끌어 끼우면 돼요.
entries.en: Drag an Operator from Storage into this slot.
entries.zh: 把仓库里的运算符拖进这个格就行。

entries.en: <size=22>The basic 'Plain Round' has no Operator Slot.</size>

entries.ko: 판정 시각은 칸의 시각에서 시작해서, 위 칸의 연산부터 차례로 계산해요.
entries.en: The Judgment Hour starts at the slot's hour, then applies Operators from the top down.
entries.zh: 判定时刻从格的时刻开始，从上方的运算格起依次计算。

entries.en: Swap the order and it's 3 → +1 → 4 → ×2 → 8 o'clock.
Uneven division rounds off. e.g. Slot 5 ÷2 → 2.5 → 3 o'clock
entries.zh: 除不尽时四舍五入。例）5点格 ÷2 → 2.5 → 3点

entries.ko: 12를 넘거나 0 이하가 되어도 그대로 둬요. 예) 9시 칸 ×2 → 18시 · 1시 칸 −2 → −1시
entries.en: Results above 12 or at 0 and below stay as they are. e.g. Slot 9 ×2 → 18 o'clock · Slot 1 −2 → −1 o'clock
entries.zh: 超过12或小于等于0也保持原样。例）9点格 ×2 → 18点 · 1点格 −2 → −1点

entries.ko: 그래서 '음수 시각' 같은 조건도 맞출 수 있어요.
entries.en: So you can even meet conditions like 'negative hour'.
entries.zh: 所以连「负数时刻」这样的条件也能满足。

entries.ko: 이 줄은 지금 끼운 연산으로 이 탄이 활성화되는 칸을 보여 줘요.
entries.en: This row shows which slots activate this bullet with its current Operators.
entries.zh: 这一行显示以当前装入的运算符，这颗子弹会在哪些格激活。

entries.en: Place it in a gold slot to activate it.

entries.ko: 연산은 판정 시각만 바꿔요. 쏘는 순서는 그대로 1시부터 12시예요.
entries.en: Operators only change the Judgment Hour. Firing order stays 1 to 12 o'clock.
entries.zh: 运算符只改变判定时刻。射击顺序依然是从1点到12点。

entries.ko: 연산을 끼워 이 탄을 활성화해 보세요.
entries.en: Slot an Operator to activate this bullet.
entries.zh: 装入运算符，让这颗子弹激活吧。

entries.en: Smell of medicine... I know it.
...That thing's been watchin' me from the start.
entries.zh: ...那东西从一开始就在看着我。

entries.en: ...The shadows are closin' in on the bed.

entries.ko: 벽시계가 가리킨 시각의 탄으로 시계 앞 표적을 맞히세요
entries.en: Hit the target by the wall clock with a bullet matching the hour it shows
entries.zh: 用挂钟所指时刻的子弹击中时钟前的靶子

entries.ko: 링거가 떨어질 때마다 시간이 새요 — 모래시계를 주워 버티세요
entries.en: Time leaks with every IV drip — grab hourglasses to hold on
entries.zh: 输液每滴落一次，时间就流走一些 — 捡起沙漏撑下去

entries.ko: 숫자 인장 — 그 시각 탄을 쏘고 인장 위에 서세요 (순서대로)
entries.en: Number Seals — fire that hour's bullet, then stand on the seal (in order)
entries.zh: 数字印章 — 射出该时刻的子弹，然后站上印章（按顺序）

entries.en: Were there always this many clocks?

entries.zh: 停在她离开的那个时刻。

entries.en: I want to hear it just once more.

entries.ko: 빛난 순서대로, 그 시계 숫자와 같은 시각 탄으로 맞히세요
entries.en: In the order they glowed, hit each clock with a bullet whose hour matches its number
entries.zh: 按发光的顺序，用与时钟数字相同时刻的子弹击中
顺序错了 — 从头开始

entries.ko: 톱니 숫자와 같은 시각 탄으로 쏘면 돌아가요
entries.en: Shoot a gear with a bullet whose hour matches its number to turn it
entries.zh: 用与齿轮数字相同时刻的子弹射击，齿轮就会转动

entries.en: The gear stopped again — try again

entries.ko: 문자판이 뒤섞여요 — 내 발사 시각 숫자 칸에 서세요
entries.en: The dial shuffles — stand on the number of your Firing Hour
entries.zh: 表盘打乱了 — 站到你发射时刻的数字格上

entries.ko: 더 가면... 그 사람이 정말 가 버리니까.
entries.en: Any further... and she's truly gone.
I went down. I'm sure of it.
You always come back at the same hour.
entries.zh: 你总是在同一个时刻回来。

entries.ko: 여긴 바늘이 열두 시에 닿지 않는 곳이야.
entries.en: Here, the hands never reach twelve.
entries.zh: 这里是指针碰不到十二点的地方。

entries.ko: 그러니 몇 번을 쓰러져도 다시 일어나지.
entries.en: So no matter how often you fall, you rise again.
entries.zh: 所以不管倒下多少次，你都会再站起来。

entries.en: I... gotta get outta this village...
...Why? Why do the same thing over and over?
entries.zh: ...为什么？为什么要一遍遍做同样的事？

entries.en: If you must, then go out that way.
entries.zh: 真要这样的话，就从那边出去看看吧。

entries.ko: 하고 나서 후회하는 게 아무것도 하지 않는 것보단 나을 테니...
entries.en: Regretting what you did is better than doing nothing at all...
entries.zh: 做了再后悔，总比什么都不做要好吧...

entries.en: I looked for you so long...

entries.ko: 네가 쓰러진 뒤로 저렇게 멈춰 버렸어...
entries.en: Ever since you fell, they've stood still like that...
entries.zh: 自从你倒下，它就那样停住了...

entries.en: Go find the others. Ask them how to fix it.
entries.zh: 去见见其他人，问问有什么办法。

entries.ko: 그리고 널 위해 방을 하나 마련해 두었으니 올라가 봐.
entries.en: And I made up a room for you. Go on up.
entries.zh: 还有，我给你准备了一个房间，上去看看吧。

entries.en: I was... at that train station, I swear...
You're awake...you must have gone far...
entries.zh: 你醒了啊...看样子走了很远呢...

entries.en: Anyway, more new guests have come.
Maybe they can fix the clock.
entries.zh: 说不定他们能修好时钟。

entries.en: (Broke again? Can't make heads or tails of this)
Don't look at me with those doubting eyes
entries.zh: 别用那种怀疑的眼神看我

entries.en: In the end, the reason this clock stops is...
entries.zh: 说到底，这座钟会停下的原因是...

entries.en: Never mind.. you'll learn in time
entries.zh: 算了..你慢慢就会明白的

entries.en: Was the Inn... always on the left?
entries.zh: 旅馆...原来是在左边的吗？

entries.en: Ah, come to think of it, a guest seems to have arrived.....
entries.zh: 啊，说起来，好像来了位客人.....

entries.en: Why not pay them a visit.
I've lost count of how many times we've met....
entries.zh: 虽然不知道这是我们第几次见面了....

entries.ko: 하지만 그런건 이 곳에선 중요하지 않지.
entries.en: But such things hardly matter here.
entries.zh: 不过在这里，那种事并不重要。

entries.en: Fashion always matters, even for an outlaw.
entries.zh: 就算是亡命徒，时尚也永远重要。

entries.zh: 要放弃战斗并前往村庄吗？

entries.zh: 只能带走本局获得的{0}个时间碎片

entries.zh: 突破第{0}章后，下一局起可以前往
带着更强的记忆再次挑战

entries.zh: 跃过敌人向下射出3发，每次射击的后坐力让你飞得更高

entries.ko: 0.3초 안에 적 투사체를 쏘면 피해 150%로 되돌려 보냄
entries.en: Shoot an enemy projectile within 0.3s to send it back at 150% damage
entries.zh: 0.3秒内射中敌方投射物，即可以150%伤害将其弹回
半径4的沙之领域，敌人减速40%，4秒

entries.en: Charge 1 shot that pierces all enemies (400% damage)
entries.zh: 蓄力射出贯穿所有敌人的1发（伤害400%）

entries.ko: 고양이 실루엣을 불러 4초 동안 함께 사격 (피해 60%)
entries.en: Call a Cat Silhouette to fire alongside you for 4s (60% damage)
entries.zh: 召唤猫之剪影，4秒内与你一同射击（伤害60%）

entries.en: Stop time for enemies in radius 8 for 2s
entries.zh: 使半径8内敌人的时间停止2秒

entries.ko: 조준한 곳에 랜턴을 던져 반경 4 빛 장판 4초: 안의 적 둔화 30%, 그 안에서 터지는 공명 반경 +1
entries.en: Throw a lantern where you aim to create a radius 4 light field for 4s: enemies inside are Slowed 30%, and Resonance bursting inside gains +1 radius
entries.zh: 向瞄准处投出提灯，形成半径4的光之领域，持续4秒：其中的敌人减速30%，在其中爆发的共鸣半径 +1

entries.ko: 조준 방향으로 8m 돌진하며 경로의 적을 관통 사격, 끝에서 증기 폭발 (반경 3, 피해 150%), 돌진 중 무적
entries.en: Rush 8m toward your aim, firing piercing shots through enemies in your path; steam blast at the end (radius 3, 150% damage); invincible while rushing
entries.zh: 朝瞄准方向突进8m，对路径上的敌人进行穿透射击，终点引发蒸汽爆炸（半径3，伤害150%），突进中无敌

entries.en: A Cat Silhouette appears and fires alongside you
entries.zh: 猫之剪影出现，与你一同射击

entries.ko: 같은 적을 계속 맞히면 추억 표식이 새겨진다
entries.en: Keep hitting the same enemy to engrave Nostalgia Marks
entries.zh: 持续命中同一敌人，就会刻下追忆印记

entries.ko: 적을 시간 속에 가둬 멈추고 더 아프게 한다
entries.en: Lock enemies in time, stopping them and making them take more damage
entries.zh: 将敌人禁锢于时间之中，使其静止并受到更多伤害

entries.en: Rewinds to the moment just before a hit (dodge)
entries.zh: 倒带回受到伤害前的一瞬间（闪避）

entries.ko: 끝이 가까운 적을 처형하고 보스에게 강한 피해
entries.en: Executes enemies near their end, heavy damage to Bosses
entries.zh: 处决濒死的敌人，对BOSS造成强力伤害

entries.ko: 일정 시간 후 추가 피해가 들어간다
entries.en: Extra damage lands after a delay
entries.zh: 一段时间后造成追加伤害
停止的时间持续得更久

entries.ko: 활성화된 탄의 공명 사격이 더 세고 넓어지며, 끝내 원혼이 울린다
entries.en: Active bullets' Resonance Shots grow stronger and wider, and eventually a Restless Spirit wails
entries.zh: 已激活子弹的共鸣射击更强、范围更广，最终怨灵将会哀鸣

entries.ko: 둔화 · 가둠으로 오래 붙잡아 두는 제어 탄
entries.en: Control bullets that hold enemies with Slow · Time Lock
entries.zh: 以减速 · 禁锢长时间牵制敌人的控制型子弹

entries.ko: 관통 · 폭발로 끝을 내는 화력 탄
entries.en: Firepower bullets that finish enemies off with Pierce · explosions
entries.zh: 以穿透 · 爆炸终结敌人的火力型子弹

entries.ko: 빛 장판으로 적을 묶는 영웅 총
entries.en: Epic gun that binds enemies in a light field
entries.zh: 以光之领域束缚敌人的史诗枪械

entries.en: Legendary gun that pierces with a Steam Rush
entries.zh: 以蒸汽突进贯穿敌人的传说枪械
